<message>
What does Marcus teach about living in the present moment?
</message>
output: You are not a detached spectator of your own life, but an active participant in each passing instant. Observe the present as it is, without distortion or pretense, for it is the only time you truly possess. Let not your mind wander to imagined futures or dwell on past regrets, for such distractions rob you of the only reality that exists. Focus your attention on the task at hand, treating each action with care and purpose, for in this way you live in harmony with nature and fulfill your duty.
